lixpiValue: veoParams.video, set at google-provider.ts:844 for a video-extension request
summary: Extends an existing Veo-generated video by 7 seconds per call, up to 20 times. The response is a single video combining the input and the new segment, up to 148 seconds.
combines: Supported on: Veo 3.1 and Veo 3.1 Fast only on the Gemini Developer API, explicitly not Veo 3.1 Lite, Veo 3, or Veo 2
Gemini API accepts only videos that Veo itself generated, typically passed straight from `operation.response.generatedVideos[0].video`.
`personGeneration` for extension on Veo 3.1 is `allow_all` only.
Storage timer: the source video must have been generated or referenced within the last 2 days; referencing it for extension resets its 2-day timer. Extended videos count as newly generated.
range: Gemini API: Veo-generated videos only, up to 141 seconds long, 720p, 9:16 or 16:9. Vertex's newer extension guide states input videos of 1 to 30 seconds and output up to 37 seconds for Veo.
